changelog:
- Initial release of the Chaterimo AI Customer Service skill for Shopify & e-commerce.
- Query and list your configured AI chatbots with their status and settings.
- Browse and filter customer conversations by date or platform, with full PII redaction.
- View complete, anonymized conversation transcripts between customers and your AI chatbot.
- Secure integration via API key (environment variable) with hashed storage and instant revocation.
- Supports Shopify, Shoptet, Upgates, and eshop-rychle.cz platforms, and major AI models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok).
summary: AI Customer Service for Shopify & E-commerce - Query conversations, analyze chatbot performance, and manage your Chaterimo AI assistant
